response.overview: This DVD chronicles the journey of both Ricky Ponting and Adam Gilchrist to their Australian captaincy, featuring some of their most outstanding tests and one-day internationals. With tributes from greats including Mark Taylor, Steve Waugh, Ian Healey, and Shane Warne, The New Guard is insightful, revealing, and ultimately a celebration of two of Australia's foremost contemporary cricket players.
response.title: The New Guard
